resources.string: Unknown numbers and loan-app spam patterns are blocked automatically. Your contacts always ring. Works fully offline: no internet or data needed.
Allow access to Contacts so your saved numbers can still ring.
Set CallShield as your \"Caller ID & spam app\".
Block numbers not in my contacts
Stops loan-app, debt-recovery and other spam calls from numbers you never saved.
Calls showing \"No caller ID\" or \"Private number\".
Allow numbers I have called before
Lets dispatch riders, your bank or a shop you phoned call you back, even if not saved. Needs call log access.
If the same unknown number calls again within 5 minutes, it rings. Useful for emergencies. Turn off if spammers keep redialling.
The phone does not ring, but the caller hears it ringing and the call shows as missed.
Notify me when a call is blocked

Works offline: CallShield needs no internet, no data and no account. Everything stays on your phone.

1. Tap "Turn on protection", allow Contacts, then tap "Set as default" when asked about the Caller ID & spam app.

2. No pop-up? Open Settings › Apps › Choose default apps › Caller ID & spam app and pick CallShield.

3. Samsung's own Phone › Settings › Block numbers › "Block unknown/private numbers" only stops hidden-ID calls. CallShield also blocks every number you have not saved.

4. Works on both SIMs. No battery settings needed: Android wakes CallShield only when a call comes in.

5. Save important numbers (bank, school, hospital, riders) in Contacts or the allow list so they always ring.

6. WhatsApp and other internet calls are not covered; block those inside WhatsApp (Settings › Privacy › Calls › Silence unknown callers).
On Samsung: Settings › Apps › Choose default apps › Caller ID & spam app › CallShield.\n\nOther phones: Settings › Apps › Default apps › Caller ID & spam app.
Contacts access is needed, otherwise CallShield cannot tell your contacts from strangers and will not block anything.
Without call log access this option cannot work.
These numbers always ring, even if not saved in Contacts. Add a prefix with * (e.g. 0201* for a landline area).

These numbers are always blocked, even if saved in Contacts. Use * for a prefix, e.g. 0700* blocks every number starting 0700. Numbers next to one on this list (same block of 1000) are also treated as spam.
Tap a number to allow it, block it permanently or call it back.

Watches how unknown numbers call you and blocks the ones that behave like loan-app and debt-recovery call centres: calling on several days, many calls spread over the day, waves of different numbers, numbers next to a known spammer, late-night calls and 020 call-centre lines. Once caught, a number is blocked straight away every time.
Pattern detection is off. Only your other rules apply.
Normal: blocks clear collector patterns. A stranger redialling quickly in an emergency still gets through.
Strict: for heavy harassment. Also blocks any number that calls 4+ times a day, and every new unknown number during a spam wave.
Ask me about unknown callers that ring
Shows a \"Block as loan spam\" button while an unknown number is ringing. Tapping it hangs up and blocks that number for good.
Scan my call history for spam numbers
Scanning the last 30 days of calls…
No numbers in your recent calls look like loan-app collectors.
%1$d numbers will be blocked immediately from now on.
One number per line, e.g. a spam list from a WhatsApp group
Marked as spam. It and similar numbers will be blocked.
Is this a loan app or spam?

This number is now blocked. Allow the \"Phone\" permission in CallShield to also hang up instantly.
